event_annotations.notes: No raw event IDs were detected in the pre-scan ('no events detected'). The CHB-MIT Scalp EEG Database (physionet.org/files/chbmit/1.0.0/) does not contain embedded event markers within the EDF files themselves. Instead, seizure annotations are stored externally in: (1) per-subject summary text files (e.g., chb01/chb01-summary.txt, chb02/chb02-summary.txt, chb03/chb03-summary.txt, chb04/chb04-summary.txt, chb05/chb05-summary.txt, chb21/chb21-summary.txt) that specify 'Number of Seizures in File', 'Seizure Start Time', and 'Seizure End Time' in seconds for each recording; and (2) binary .seizures files (e.g., chb21/chb21_19.edf.seizures, chb21/chb21_21.edf.seizures) with a time resolution header (256 Hz). Since no event IDs were extracted from the data files and the annotations exist only as external metadata without discrete event IDs to map, no annotations can be produced. The dataset structure consists of subjects (chb01-chb24) with numbered recording sessions, but all event timing information is stored outside the EDF event channels.

derived_misc_channels.name: seizure_state_label
derived_misc_channels.derivation: For each 30-second segment, determine if it falls entirely before a seizure (pre-ictal), during a seizure (ictal, between seizure_start and seizure_end events), or neither (inter-ictal). Requires parsing seizure onset/offset annotations from EDF+ annotations or separate .seizure files in CHB-MIT. Pre-ictal window typically defined as 30-90 min before onset per domain convention.
derived_misc_channels.groundable_evidence: No events.tsv columns discovered; annotations are embedded in EDF headers or .seizure companion files. Kernel must extract seizure onset/offset times from native CHB-MIT annotation format.

derived_misc_channels.groundable_evidence: No native events.tsv columns; annotations embedded in EDF headers or companion .seizure files per CHB-MIT documentation.
